title: Circuit Overlap Measurement Tool: How Much Do Different Discovery Methods Agree?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If two methods return circuits with low overlap, at least one is wrong. A circuit overlap tool directly validates safety-relevant circuit claims. This is foundational infrastructure for trusting any circuit-based safety argument.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running two circuit discovery methods on GPT-2-Small IOI is feasible with TransformerLens. Building the Jaccard similarity utility is simple Python. However, getting ACDC and path patching to produce comparable edge-list formats requires understanding both methods. Moderate complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two methods minimum, three tasks for validation, plus visualization. The core utility (Jaccard over edge sets) is simple, but running multiple methods across multiple tasks expands scope. Could be narrowed to two methods on one task.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
